title: CoreError alias origin undocumented
description: crates/core/src/error.rs line 280 defines 'pub type CoreError = ValidationError'. The comment says 'Backwards-compatibility alias. New code should use ValidationError directly.' A new contributor has no context: what was CoreError before the rename, which external callers still rely on it, and whether it will be removed. Clarify origin and removal plan in the doc comment.
